answer: You want 1,000 fake identities. Each starts with 2 task slots. Every verified epoch adds 2, capped at 40. Idle for 3 epochs and the quota falls back by 4. One fraud resets the quota to 2 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs, and a repeat offense doubles the climb. A grove of clones grows slowly or not at all. A ledge of 1,000 high-quota identities needs 19 epochs of real work, costing about 152,000 units. A hollow army of fresh clones earns almost nothing per epoch. You pay full price for every slot. The math kills the business model before the first payout.
